title: Working on this game for 4 months
author: Weak-Staff7594
selftext:
I’ve been working on this casual sort puzzle game for like 4 months now and im finally ready to share it with people for some critics and insights  
Its still a working progress. Mechacal bugs, visual bugs and sound bugs are here and there but i am currently fixing a lot of things. I would really appreciate any usefull feedback. This is my first game ever and i learnt a lot from it, sorry for my grammar.

comments.author: The30sclub
comments.body: Wao nice style and nice idea ! Keep going 💪🏽💪🏽

comments.author: The30sclub
comments.body: How did you integrated to login with the platform?

replies.author: Weak-Staff7594
replies.body: Sign in with Apple → Firebase Auth (`sign_in_with_apple` \+ `firebase_auth`), saves in Firestore. Login is optional, everyone starts on a device-local id and signing in just promotes it to a permanent uid.

comments.author: RevenueChemical6910
comments.body:
Nice what's your process like? 

What models did you use for game art? It's the most difficult thing for me, how do you structure your prompts to get consistency?

replies.author: Weak-Staff7594
replies.body: Hey man this is my first project and im still learning but, first thing i did was choosing a color palette, art style then i did ui elements but it was hard to get a consistency i remember like doing couple things for 20 times until i got a good asset.
